page: Microsoft Azure L96as_v5 is a member of the Lasv5 server family, utilizing AMD processors on the x86_64 architecture. This virtualized instance runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and features 96 dedicated virtual CPUs. It is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, which translates to a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

A primary characteristic of the L96as_v5 is its substantial local storage capacity, providing 23,038 GB of local storage. The instance is Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-performance disk configurations. There are no integrated GPUs on this server type, and it does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the high ratio of local storage capacity to compute resources, this instance offers high resource density for storage-intensive operations. The combination of 96 dedicated vCPUs, 768.0 GB of RAM, and over 23 TB of local storage makes it highly suitable for large-scale databases, big data analytics, and storage-heavy enterprise applications.
